title: Northeastern Uni at Multilingual Counterspeech Generation: Enhancing Counter Speech Generation with LLM Alignment through Direct Preference Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality of generated counter-narratives against Islamophobic and Antisemitic hate speech using automated text metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore) and an LLM-as-a-judge (JudgeLM).
Evaluating the quality and factual accuracy of generated counter-narratives against racially charged hate speech and slurs using reference-based text metrics and LLM-based evaluation.
Assessing model-generated counter-speech defending LGBT individuals against homophobic hate speech using similarity metrics and LLM-based evaluation.
Measuring the contextual relevance and quality of generated counter-speech responding to anti-migrant and xenophobic statements using automated text generation metrics.
